quests.title: The Art of Horticulture

dialogue.t: These are... seeds?
These are Naku Weed seeds.
Well, I kind of know about it. I've seen this plant before and I've heard people talk about its wonders.
I remember that... even in the absence of wind, this plant will tremble slightly to the sound of thunder...

dialogue.sit: Does it look good when grown?

dialogue.t: If we're talking about appearance alone... I daresay it looks rather nice indeed.
Would you like to try growing some Naku Weeds? But I don't believe there to be any suitable land hereabouts...

dialogue.sit: I have my own plot of land.

dialogue.t: Oh, is that so? As expected of you... So, you have even been gifted land already?
Pardon me for asking, but is your land...
Oh! I have also heard tell of your feats in Mondstadt and Liyue, Madam(Sir).
Indeed, it would be more surprising if you were not gifted land for such deeds!
Hey, {NICKNAME}, the land you're talking about is the Serenitea Pot that Granny gave us, right?
Can you really grow things in there? Granny didn't say anything about it before...

dialogue.sit: Let's go back and ask her.
The adepti are very powerful after all.

dialogue.t: Okay then, let's go back and ask Granny.
Hmm? Hello children, are you here to see me?
Seeds... Ah, so you'd like to grow these seeds in the Serenitea Pot?
I suppose that's no problem. The Serenitea Pot is your little realm, after all.
It's just that you've only brought this bag of seeds today. Are you only planning to plant this one bag of seeds?
Oh, that's right! We don't even know how to collect seeds...
After we plant this bag of seeds, where do we go to find more...
There, there, don't worry. I happen to have a little box here that I used many years ago.
When I used to plant flowers, they were all kept in this little box. The flowers grown in the box can be preserved for a long time.
Moreover, after putting the flowers in the box, it can produce several flower seeds... This makes sowing them very convenient indeed.
Although this box is somewhat less useful now... but it still retains the power to "generate seeds."
Hmm... I don't use it much now anyway... So, why don't I give it to you?
This box should come in handy, whether you want to grow some flowers and plants, or some crops.
Thank you, Granny!
Oh children, you don't have to be so polite. Go ahead and give it a try, but I must say that it's not an easy task to take care of flowers and plants, so you should be prepared.
Granny is really powerful indeed... but before we try that box out, let's go back to our teapot and try to sow those seeds.
Hmm, Paimon really hopes that they'll grow soon...

quests.description: You have obtained a bag of Naku Weed seeds in Inazuma, but if you want to plant them in the Serenitea Pot, you might need to ask Madame Ping for some pointers…
